data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO stage Defense & Security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski, Adam Bartosiewicz, and Krzysztof Wysocki. The company operates within a sector comprising 21 peer companies across public and private markets. The comp universe includes 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, with notable private-stage counterparts including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems.

The peer-median methodology was not applicable to this analysis. Despite identifying 21 same-sector peers in Defense & Security, the narrow filtering criteria—matching on stage (pre-IPO), adjacent stage proximity, and similar valuation tier—yielded fewer than three datapoints necessary for reliable peer-median triangulation. A forced all-sector median approach would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security sub-segments and company maturity profiles.

Without a sufficient filtered peer set, traditional comparable company valuation cannot be reliably executed. A defensible valuation range for WB Group cannot be established from the data provided. To advance the analysis, additional information is required on either: (1) WB Group's revenue, EBITDA, or other financial metrics enabling revenue or earnings multiple approaches; (2) transaction data from the identified private peers (Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, Quantum-Systems); or (3) expansion of the comp universe to include adjacent defense sub-sectors with deeper datasets. The primary uncertainty remains the lack of quantitative anchoring metrics for the target company itself.
